one_liner: Pay-as-you-go API platform providing SERP, keyword, backlink, on-page, domain analytics, and other SEO/marketing data.

api_breadth_note: 10+ API modules (SERP, Keywords Data, OnPage, Labs, Backlinks, Business Data, Domain Analytics, Content Analysis, AI Optimization, Merchant) covering nearly the full SEO data surface.
existing_mcp_note: Official MCP server, hosted endpoint mcp.dataforseo.com/mcp, billed against your existing API account.

evidence.note: Confirms HTTP Basic Authentication using account email + API password.
Confirms official MCP server and hosted endpoint.

researcher_notes: Uses HTTP Basic Auth (login/password) — atypical auth scheme for agent tooling worth flagging.

one_liner: SEO platform (rank tracking, backlinks, keyword research, site audits, AI search visibility) exposed via a Data API and a Project API.
access_note: A standalone 14-day API trial (100k credits, no credit card) is self-serve; sustained use requires an Essential+ paid subscription or purchased PAYG credit packs.
api_breadth_note: Covers SERP, backlinks, domain analysis, keyword research, AI search visibility, website audit, plus a separate Project API.
existing_mcp_note: MCP listed as a first-class integration, included in the API trial credits.

evidence.note: Confirms Token-scheme Authorization header and per-plan credit allowances.
Lists MCP as an official integration.

researcher_notes: Data API is credit-metered pay-as-you-go while Project API draws on normal subscription limits.

one_liner: SEO/backlink/keyword/competitive-research platform (Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, Rank Tracker, Brand Radar, etc.) with a REST API and MCP.
access_note: Meaningful API v3 / MCP access requires an eligible paid plan starting at Lite ($129/mo); only a small set of free test queries is available otherwise.
api_breadth_note: Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, Rank Tracker, SERP Overview, Batch Analysis, Brand Radar, Web Analytics, GSC Insights, Social Media Management.
existing_mcp_note: Official hosted MCP, available on Lite plan and up; ToS forbids hitting the MCP endpoint via custom/unsupported clients.
main_blocker: Requires a paid plan (from $129/mo) for real API/MCP access, and the MCP endpoint disallows generic custom-client usage.

evidence.note: Confirms API key auth, eligibility tied to paid plans, rate limit, unit-based cost model.
Confirms MCP is paid-plan gated and restricts use to supported AI tool integrations.

researcher_notes: Two distinct blockers: cost (paid plan) and a contractual restriction on building custom MCP clients.

one_liner: AI-powered web scraping platform (natural-language scraper creation, bulk scraping, proxies) with REST API, CLI, SDKs, and MCP.

api_breadth_note: Scoped to scraper creation/execution, bulk scraping, HTML fetching, and results retrieval — narrower than general-purpose platforms like Apify or Bright Data.
existing_mcp_note: Official cloud-hosted MCP server exposing 8 tools (create_scraper, bulk_rerun, fetch_html, get_all_results, etc.).

evidence.note: Confirms Bearer/x-api-token header auth.
Confirms official remote MCP server and tool list.

researcher_notes: Smaller/newer vendor but surprisingly complete for agent use.

one_liner: Marketplace/platform of 7,000+ serverless "Actors" (scrapers, crawlers, automations) with a unified execution and data-retrieval API.
access_note: Free account signup immediately issues an API token with a free usage tier; further usage is pay-as-you-go per compute unit.
api_breadth_note: Generic platform API to discover, run, and manage any of 7,000+ Actors/scrapers plus datasets, key-value stores, webhooks, and schedules.
existing_mcp_note: Official Apify MCP Server, hosted at mcp.apify.com, plus a local stdio option.

evidence.note: Confirms Bearer-token auth in Authorization header.
Confirms official hosted MCP server.

access_note: Free tier includes 1,000 credits/month with no credit card required; paid plans start around $16/mo, and a keyless mode also exists for limited daily search/scrape.

one_liner: Large-scale web-data infrastructure (residential/datacenter proxies, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraping Browser, dataset marketplace) for scraping at scale.

api_breadth_note: Proxy networks, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraping Browser, and a scraper/dataset marketplace — one of the broadest data-collection surfaces reviewed.
existing_mcp_note: Official brightdata-mcp with a free Rapid-mode tool subset and a paid parameter unlocking 70+ tools.

evidence.note: Confirms API-key (Bearer) and native proxy-credential auth methods.
Confirms official MCP server maintained by Bright Data.

researcher_notes: Some third-party review sites claim the 'free trial' for some products actually routes through a sales call/KYC — likely varies by product line.

one_liner: Open-source Python CLI tool that checks whether a given username exists across 400+ social networks/websites by probing profile URLs.
access_note: Free, open-source CLI (pip/pipx install); no account, API key, or hosted endpoint required at all — it runs entirely locally.
api_breadth_note: Single function: check one username's existence across a fixed list of ~400 sites; no other data types or endpoints.
existing_mcp_note: No official MCP server found; an old, separately-hosted REST wrapper exists but has been unmaintained since 2021.
main_blocker: No hosted/official network API — an agent toolkit must shell out to the CLI as a subprocess rather than call a remote endpoint.

evidence.note: Community discussion confirming CLI usage pattern, no API keys/login needed.
Independent OSINT toolkit description confirming Sherlock is a local CLI tool.

researcher_notes: This is a CLI tool, not a hosted API — matches the task's framing exactly.

one_liner: B2B contact/company data enrichment API that waterfalls a single request across 30+ underlying data vendors to maximize match rate for emails, phones, and firmographics.
access_note: Real, well-built REST API docs exist (x-api-key auth), but the public marketing site's only signup CTA is 'Book a call,' and the FAQ states they are 'very selective' about who can build products on Waterfall data.
api_breadth_note: Prospector, Search Contact/Company, Contact/Phone/Company Enrichment, Company Reveal, Company Titles, Job Change Detection, Email Verification.
existing_mcp_note: No official or community MCP server found for Waterfall.io.
main_blocker: No confirmed public self-serve signup — obtaining an initial API key appears to require going through 'Book a call'/sales.

evidence.note: Confirms real REST API with x-api-key auth and a full endpoint list.
Homepage's only CTA is 'Book a call'; FAQ states they are selective about partnering.

researcher_notes: Small/niche vendor — genuine detailed developer docs exist but no confirmed public self-serve signup; a human should try the actual signup flow.

one_liner: GTM/data-enrichment workspace that waterfalls 100+ data providers for people/company search and enrichment, now also offering a public developer API and coding-agent plugin.
access_note: Self-serve trial signup exists for the product itself, but programmatic access is plan-gated: webhook/API usage requires Explorer plan or above, and the native People/Company API is Enterprise-only.
api_breadth_note: New Public API exposes Searches, Routines, and Enterprise-only Tables; separately, in-table HTTP API and webhook features let Clay call third-party APIs.
existing_mcp_note: No traditional MCP server found; Clay instead ships a coding-agent plugin/CLI for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
main_blocker: Full programmatic access is tiered behind paid plans, and the Public API itself is very new (since ~mid-2026).

evidence.note: Confirms the new Public API (Searches, Routines, Tables) and the coding-agent plugin.
Confirms plan gating: webhook API access requires Explorer+.

researcher_notes: Until mid-2026 Clay had no real public API at all — Public API and agent plugin are brand new, documentation/tooling still sparse.
